name: Slonks Slop Game
description: The void and $SLOP game for Slonks: it locks tokens for claims, computes slop, and holds voided Slonks.
about:
## Role in the Slonks system

This contract (SlopGameV2) is the hub of the Slonks game economy. It computes each token's slop (the pixel divergence from the original punk, 0 to 576), lets holders lock Slonks before a successful proof moves them into the void and mints the **$SLOP** token (`0x999b49c0d1612e619a4a4f6280733184da025108`), and exposes the active merge and embedding state that the **SlonksRenderer** (`0x726383bd28fa1f95a7e3d300babf08f6444d0437`) reads.

It is an authorized metadata updater on the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`), so it can trigger ERC-4906 refreshes when state changes. It is wired to the live **SlonksMergeManager** (`0x7bda4820dbcfe471a2e23d3fa069c1cd261401e1`).

## Slop claim verification

The on-chain model-output verifier for `claimSlop` is currently a stub, `RejectingSlopVerifier` (`0x5e054061de6d79b7f52f6c23a55787a39f0169ce`), which rejects proofs; verification is not yet live. The owner can replace it via `setModelOutputVerifier`.
risks: The owner can change the model-output verifier, game extensions, and protocol voiders
The claimSlop verifier is currently a stub that rejects all proofs

isInVoid.title: Is In Void
isInVoid.description: Whether a token is currently locked in the void.

voidedCount.title: Voided Count
voidedCount.description: How many Slonks are currently in the void.

buyAndVoidSlonk.title: Buy and Void
buyAndVoidSlonk.description: Spend accrued protocol ETH through a marketplace or router to buy a Slonk and place it in the void.
buyAndVoidSlonk.warning: Uses protocol funds and caller-supplied purchase calldata. The caller sends no ETH, and no $SLOP is minted.

claimSlop.title: Claim Slop
claimSlop.description: Submit a model-output proof for a locked Slonk, moving it into the void and minting $SLOP if valid.
claimSlop.deprecated: Unavailable: the currently configured verifier rejects every proof.

isSlopClaimPending.title: Is Slop Claim Pending
isSlopClaimPending.description: Whether a Slonk is locked in game custody and still awaits a successful claim proof.

lockSlonk.title: Lock Slonk
lockSlonk.description: Transfer one of your Slonks into game custody while awaiting a model-output claim proof.
lockSlonk.warning: The token can be unlocked only before a claim succeeds and moves it into the void.

unlockSlonk.title: Unlock Slonk
unlockSlonk.description: Unlock one of your previously locked Slonks.

slopToken.title: Slop Token
slopToken.description: The $SLOP ERC-20 token minted by voiding Slonks.
